title: The plank test: how long can you hold a plank on your knees?
caption: How long can you hold a plank on your knees? Count the seconds, then find your level: Wall Plank, Knee Plank, Full Plank or Plank Shoulder Tap. Save this and retest in two weeks.

overlays.text: How long can you hold a plank on your knees? Try it, then swipe.

scenes.footer: Stop when your hips sag or lift. That number is your result.

overlays.text: Forearms down, knees down, body in one line. Count the seconds you can hold it.

scenes.footer: Do this every day. Move on when 20 seconds feels steady.

overlays.text: Start here. Wall Plank. 20 seconds. Hands on the wall, walk your feet back, hold.

scenes.footer: Move on when 25 seconds feels steady.

overlays.text: Knee Plank. 25 seconds. Forearms and knees down, body in one line, hold.

scenes.footer: Move on when you hold all 30 seconds and your hips stay level.

overlays.text: Full Plank. 30 seconds. Forearms down, knees off the floor, body in one line.

scenes.footer: You passed. Move on when your hips stay still for all 10.

overlays.text: Plank Shoulder Tap. 10 reps. High plank on your hands, tap one shoulder at a time.

scenes.footer: The wall and shoulder tap versions load the wrists. The forearm ones do not.

overlays.text: Do your level every day. Take the plank test again in two weeks.

scenes.footer: Save this and retest in two weeks.

overlays.text: How many seconds did you hold?
